title: Blocked image generation should throw
author: mbleigh

comments.body:
Hi @mbleigh 

I assume for both cases, you are talking about the `models.generateImages()` method is it? Because there are two ways to obtain images, one is by using `models.generateImages()`, another is by using `models.generateContent()` with a `responseModalites = ['TEXT', 'IMAGE']` config.

For `models.generateImages()` there are 2 common reasons why images may not be generated, which you listed above.

1) Prompt could not be submitted. This means that the user's prompt failed the filter checks, so no image generation can be done. This throws an error

2) The prompt is fine, but the model produced (at least) some results that failed the filter checks. Sometimes if multiple images are requested, some images may be filtered out, while others can pass through. That's why there is the field raiFilteredReason, to help explain what happened. It would be inconsistent to change the behavior of throwing on raiFilteredReason depending on the number of images requested, so we do not throw an error if any raiFilteredReason

> "if I try to generate images and none are returned, how is it anything other than an exception?"

There are certain parameters that can return metadata about blocked images (include_rai_reason, include_safety_attributes) which should be returned without throwing an exception.

This is also the API's behavior, so the SDK will not be doing anything to change this behavior.
